## #1 — Edward — 2014-08-24
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/10625/post-89421>

Read MQO

Read MQO

Description

Imports a .mqo file exported from the Metasequoia modeling application. Only geometry is created, since the javascript API doesn't currently support editing materials. Unfortunately there is a memory leak somewhere, so large models can't be loaded because memory is quickly consumed until the script ends.

Getting Started

Place the script into the Tool scripts folder and restart Cheetah3D. On my system, this folder is located at ~/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/Scripts/Tool.

Greg
